purpose: Teach: 捉える/深海/追放/パンク/捏造/形跡/失調/大名

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、本気で、絶対、捉える、絶対、視点、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, the way you grasped that perspective in your paper was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, steady voice with a note of real admiration. Measured pace. Slight pause after her name—making this personal, not just professional feedback.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本気で、絶対、深海、絶対、生態、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really did try to give the deep-sea ecology thorough treatment in my research.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Not over-performed gratitude. Clear, steady voice. Slight warmth underneath—she means it, not just being polite. Minimal flourish.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、追放、絶対、され、絶対、た、絶対、思想家、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled those exiled thinkers—that was really thoughtful work.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly in tone. Deliberate, like she's pointing out something specific she noticed. Warm but focused. The praise lands because it's detailed, not generic.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。電力網の、本気で、絶対、パンク、絶対、現象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I worked really hard to analyze the grid collapse phenomenon carefully in that section.
lines.style: Quieter than before. A touch of vulnerability—like she's admitting how much effort it took. Still composed, but you can hear the sincerity beneath. No bravado.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: データの、本気で、絶対、捏造、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of data manipulation and its implications was especially well done.
lines.style: Nodding in her voice. Slower, more deliberate than her first feedback. This is something she wants Sakura to hear clearly. Steady, affirming tone. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古代遺跡の、本気で、絶対、形跡、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I tried to approach the archaeological evidence with real care and attention to detail.
lines.style: Still respectful, but slightly more relaxed than before. The back-and-forth is settling her. Steady breath. A hint of quiet pride underneath—not arrogance, just honest relief that her work was seen.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自律神経の、本気で、絶対、失調、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you connected everything to autonomic dysfunction shows real depth of understanding.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate delivery on this one. She's saving this for last on purpose—the real insight. Warm, almost contemplative. This isn't just feedback; it's recognition. Let it breathe.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦国時代の、本気で、絶対、大名、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really did put everything I had into understanding the daimyo in that historical context.
lines.style: Quieter, warmer close. The formality is still there but it's gentler now—she's let Asuka in a little. Slight trailing soften at the end. Relief and gratitude without needing to say how much this feedback meant.
